# Klynge SYD (Nordjylland)

Klynge SYD is one of the health clusters (sundhedsklynge) in Region Nordjylland covered by Denmark's national clinical quality program for atrial fibrillation (AFDK)[^src1]. According to the data reported for Indicator 5 — which measures the incidence of ischemic stroke — Klynge SYD did not meet the required standard[^src1]. The reported figures for this cluster were "Nej 31 / 2.785 0 (0) 1,1 (0,8-1,6)," indicating a "No" (Nej) result against the standard, a count of 31 out of 2,785 patients, and an associated rate of 1,1 with a confidence interval of 0,8–1,6[^src1].

It is important not to confuse this organization with the other cluster of the same name found elsewhere in the country: this Klynge SYD is located in Nordjylland, and is distinct from Klynge SYD in Region Syddanmark, which appears elsewhere in the AFDK reporting and should not be conflated with this entity.

The mention sits within a broader document chunk discussing Indicator 4b (P-creatinin measurement among DOAC patients) and Indicator 5 (incidence of ischemic stroke) across Danish health clusters and regions[^src1]. The chunk notes that Region Nordjylland was the best-performing region for Indicator 4b overall, even as individual clusters within the region — such as Klynge SYD — fell short of the standard on Indicator 5[^src1]. The underlying data for this reporting comes from national registries, including the Landspatientregisteret, Lægemiddelstatistikregisteret, and Laboratorieregistret, and the document discusses implications for patient care, including the need for better monitoring of kidney function and improved communication between hospitals and primary care[^src1].

No relationships or additional claims involving Klynge SYD (Nordjylland) are documented in the corpus beyond this single indicator result, and no related entities are listed for this page.
